reviews.text: Great clinic, the staff are very helpful, and great with my dogs.

We were very disappointed with our visit. We brought our cat in to check for ringworm and to have a routine deworming treatment, as well as flea treatment if necessary. The vet who should have took care of our cat name was Hesus.
We’re regular clients and treatments were always seamless with other vets.

What should have been a simple and routine visit turned into an extremely stressful experience for both us and our cat. The vet struggled to give the tablet and eventually crushed it and administered it very forcefully into our cat’s mouth using a syringe. After the liquid containing the crushed tablet was injected into his throat, our cat started foaming at the mouth. When we pointed this out, the vet simply told us that this was normal.

The cat became extremely frightened and struggled so much that he scratched my hands. The liquid from the syringe also ended up all over our clothes. Afterwards, the vet wiped the cat’s face quite roughly, which appeared painful and made him even more frightened.

Our cat was visibly terrified throughout the procedure and became very reluctant to go near the vet. We felt that the entire situation could have been handled with much more patience, care and gentleness.

Unfortunately, we left with a very negative impression of the way our cat was handled and the level of care provided. It was an unnecessarily stressful and upsetting experience for both our cat and us.
